paper.title: Algorithm 720: an adaptive cubature over a collection of 3-dimensional simplices (DCUTET)

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 720 archive 720.gz: one Fortran file 720.shar holding DCUTET and the DTEST1 sample program)

claim.text: DTEST1 sample program: RESULT, the integral of exp(x*x+y*y+z*z) over the reference tetrahedron (0,0,0),(1,0,0),(0,1,0),(0,0,1), EPSREL 1e-5, EPSABS 0, MAXPTS 1000. Shipped sample output 'Output produced on a SUN 3/50': RESULT = 0.22779999698986. Absolute tolerance 1e-5.

values.name: DTEST1 RESULT (integral of exp(x^2+y^2+z^2) over the reference tetrahedron)

attempt: Reproduced with a build-only change of unpacking. The shipped 720.shar is one Fortran file whose first 71 lines are a comment block and then an unprefixed Makefile fragment (non-Fortran), so the authors' archive does not compile as shipped. The Fortran lines were split by line ranges into dcutet.f (from D1MACH, line 72, through the double-precision code) and dtest1.f (DTEST1 and F, lines 1867-1907) without editing a line; the 71 header lines are left out. The unit is compiled with gfortran 13 (conda-forge gfortran_linux-64, -O0; pass 2 -O2) and linked with DTEST1. DTEST1 prints RESULT = 0.22779999698985759 (ERROR 1.975e-6, NEVAL 43, IFAIL 0), against the shipped 0.22779999698986: difference 4e-15, far inside 1e-5. Judgment call recorded: the header removal is treated as unpacking, not as a patch; if a reviewer reads it as a patch, the G2 paper check is needed.

original_attempt.reason: gfortran 13 on the shipped 720.f (the archive as one file): compile fails at the Makefile fragment in the header ("Non-numeric character in statement label", 25 errors); the link of a single unit would also fail on the four PROGRAM units.
